# PLAN — iteration 1

## Current state assessment
The baseline passes simulation and uses 79 LUTs and 66 FFs, but routed setup fails at WNS −0.432 ns while hold passes at WHS +0.012 ns. The reported critical path runs from `v3_reg` through readiness logic to the `in_ready` output; clock and pad delays dominate. Timing recovery is the first objective, with the known top annotation `// @latency 3` and all cycle behavior fixed.

## Hypothesis
Register the three-slot-full condition and combine it with the live `out_ready` input to preserve exact combinational readiness while reducing occupancy logic on the path to `in_ready`, potentially improving routed setup slack at the cost of one FF.

## Instruction for generator
In `signed_fir4_core`, add a synchronous-reset full-occupancy register whose next value tracks whether all three valid slots will be occupied after the current edge, using the existing ready/valid next-state rules. Drive `in_ready` as `!full_registered || out_ready`, preserving its immediate response to `out_ready` and the exact slot-capacity behavior; retain all three elastic slots and their transfer timing. Keep the top interface, synchronous active-high reset priority, accepted-sample history updates, registered output behavior, and top `// @latency 3` annotation unchanged; verify reset, stalls, full replacement, and timing/hold gates.
